author: John Hammond
description:
Someone I work with gave me a heads-up that they had a big TeamPCP story coming.

The story was that TeamPCP had been deanonymized, and I ended up going down the rabbit hole to recreate the investigation and follow the public clues that connected the different accounts, aliases, and infrastructure.

Full video: https://youtu.be/nj9e2Qfe3Cc?si=cLcEZFbj75Rqa7R1
title: TeamPCP OSINT Investigation
